title: Enforce reusable blocking dependency audits
description:
One reusable security workflow blocks pull requests and release callers on audit installation, data-source, or advisory failure.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The security workflow runs on pull requests and workflow_call, installs a pinned cargo-audit with --locked, and executes cargo audit -D warnings plus both npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=info commands against committed locks.
- [hard] REQ-02: Installation, registry/database, and finding failures propagate as job failures; the workflow contains no continue-on-error, shell fallback, blanket ignore, or advisory allowlist.
- [hard] REQ-03: The shared workflow-verification harness proves each of the three audit boundaries prevents caller success and all downstream release jobs remain unstarted.

## Notes

Blast radius: `.github/workflows/security-audit.yml` plus declarations consumed by the shared workflow-verification harness; gate-preset examples remain configuration examples, not hosted-release substitutes.
